elaine (AE): Hey team — new POC ask. Customer: regulated manufacturing site, fully isolated (no persistent egress). POC window ~1 week onsite. Constraints: intermittent USB/sneakernet updates only, single-node install in an airgapped rack, available disk ~12GB for app+models, procurement wants full SBOM + chain-of-custody. Questions: packaging/size limits, delta update approach, offline license activation, emergency hotfix path, telemetry opt-out. Who can confirm feasibility and proposed runbook?

Devin (SE): Short answer: doable but needs tradeoffs. Plan outline: compact quantized model (q8/q4) + minimal runtime, delta bundles for weights+manifests, signed activation blob for licensing, offline attestation for SBOM.

Devin (SE): Recommendations: 1) Target bundle <200MB for initial install (we can split model into chunked shards if needed). 2) Regular deltas <50MB using binary diff + gz. 3) Use HMAC+RSA-signed manifest for chain-of-custody. 4) Telemetry disabled by default with explicit opt-in.

ops (Platform): Note on disk: 12GB is tight. If initial bundle >8GB we need to stream-install and remove build-time artifacts. Also set KV cache on tmpfs? better to tune cache size: --kv-cache-size=256MB.

deploy-bot: artifact: release-2026-03-12-compact.tar.gz size=95MB sha256=3b7f7a2c9d1e4f3e2a9c7f8b1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b

Sam (PM): For upgrade cadence: recommend scheduled quarterly updates for features/security, with an emergency hotfix path (signed hotpatch) available 24/7 via our support SOW. Hotpatch constraints: single-file diff, <=50MB, signed and verified by device before apply. Also need rollback plan in bundle.

Harry (Legal): Procurement will require: SBOM (SPDX), signature chain, export-control checklist, and a COI for on-site transport. They typically want proof of image signing (not just tar checksum). Can we provide HSM-signed manifests?

Devin (SE): Yes — we can produce an HSM-signed manifest. Example validation steps for customer (to include in runbook):
```
# on customer airgapped host
shasum -a 256 release-2026-03-12-compact.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify public.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json
# apply delta (example)
bspatch model.bin model.bin.new model.delta
```

Devin (SE): Also recommend test harness for offline activation: customer runs the activation verifier that validates signed activation blob contains customer ID + expiry. Activation is offline; we produce signed token file that customer drops into /etc/redwood/activation.token.

ops (Platform): Operational tip: avoid auto-updates when telemetry==off. Provide a manual apply script and a dry-run flag so site can validate before switching. Also provide a small health-check binary that reports local-only status (no egress).

Sam (PM): Cost/pricing note for AE: offline POC packaging & HSM signing is a one-time engineering fee + per-POC packaging charge. I'll share numbers in a separate doc.

elaine (AE): Great — I'll summarize and send to customer security and procurement. Will ask for their preferred transport (USB vs courier) and whether they can accept a streaming install. Tentative POC kickoff Thu 09:00 local. Thanks all :thumbsup:
